answers: Does a POST list or search route in the auth server get a per-user response filter, or only GET routes?
How do I add per-user filtering to a FastAPI search endpoint that uses POST?
Where is the response filter looked up for a FastAPI endpoint in the auth server?
body:
Path: mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py request authorization for FastAPI routes. `_get_gateway_validator` maps gateway paths to validators, and `FASTAPI_ENDPOINT_RESPONSE_FILTERS` maps handler functions to response filters that rewrite the JSON body before it is returned. Existing entries cover jobs search, MCP endpoint search and MCP server get.
Rule: For a list route whose visible set depends on per-resource permissions, return `_get_require_authentication_validator()` for that path in `_get_gateway_validator`, then add a filter in `FASTAPI_ENDPOINT_RESPONSE_FILTERS` keyed by the handler function. Import the handler from its module (as `_list_gateway_models_endpoint` from mlflow/server/gateway_api.py:list_models) so the dict key is the same function object the router serves. The filter parses the body, keeps only items the user can access, and re-serializes it. `_find_fastapi_response_filter(request)` resolves the filter from the endpoint function alone and does not check the HTTP method, so a POST collection route such as jobs search (mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_filter_search_jobs) is filtered the same way as a GET list.
Constraints: Per-item permission checks in a filter cost one check per item, so this pattern fits low-frequency listings only. Add the new path to `test_find_fastapi_validator_handles_static_prefix` in tests/server/auth/test_auth.py, including the static-prefix variant. A new gateway_router route is also expected to return 501 when the gateway is disabled, as checked in tests/server/test_gateway_disable.py.
applies: FastAPI routes in the auth server that return collections filtered by user permissions; not for routes that check a single resource by id.

says: Users can see background jobs in search results that they lack permissions to access.
Filter job search results so members only see items they are authorized to view.
Unauthorized models appear in the model catalog search for restricted accounts.
Hide inaccessible gateway endpoints from users searching the shared directory.
Restricted users should not see private jobs when searching the workspace.
search: FastAPI collection routes in the auth server whose visible items depend on per-resource permissions use `_get_require_authentication_validator()` in `_get_gateway_validator` and a response filter registered in `FASTAPI_ENDPOINT_RESPONSE_FILTERS`. `_find_fastapi_response_filter(request)` resolves the filter solely from the endpoint function object, so POST search collection routes such as `_filter_search_jobs` are filtered identically to GET lists. This pattern applies only to low-frequency collection listings because per-item checks run per item, not to routes checking a single resource by id. New routes must be added to `test_find_fastapi_validator_handles_static_prefix` in `tests/server/auth/test_auth.py` and return 501 when the gateway is disabled as checked in `tests/server/test_gateway_disable.py`.
